statements.status_notes: GHSA-GCJH-H69Q-9W9G affects github.com/google/cel-go versions 0.22.0 through 0.28.1, fixed in 0.29.0. The apisix-ingress-controller image depends on k8s.io/apiserver@v0.32.3 which has transitive dependency constraints that prevent upgrading cel-go to 0.29.0. Attempting to pin cel-go@v0.29.0 causes a compilation error due to API incompatibility: 'cannot use ext.TwoVarComprehensions (value of type func(options ...ext.TwoVarComprehensionsOption) cel.EnvOption) as func() cel.EnvOption value'. This is a known incompatibility pattern affecting multiple Kubernetes ecosystem projects. Remediation requires either an upstream apisix-ingress-controller release with updated k8s.io dependencies that support cel-go 0.29.0+, or a backported security patch to the 0.22.x branch.

GHSA-GCJH-H69Q-9W9G affects github.com/google/cel-go versions 0.22.0 through 0.28.1, fixed in 0.29.0. The apisix-ingress-controller image depends on k8s.io/apiserver@v0.32.3 which has transitive dependency constraints that prevent upgrading cel-go to 0.29.0. Attempting to pin cel-go@v0.29.0 causes a compilation error due to API incompatibility: 'cannot use ext.TwoVarComprehensions (value of type func(options ...ext.TwoVarComprehensionsOption) cel.EnvOption) as func() cel.EnvOption value'. This is a known incompatibility pattern affecting multiple Kubernetes ecosystem projects. Remediation requires either an upstream apisix-ingress-controller release with updated k8s.io dependencies that support cel-go 0.29.0+, or a backported security patch to the 0.22.x branch.

This vulnerability requires ext.NativeTypes with ext.ParseStructTag to expose fields marked with a skip tag. The shipped Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 1.32 binary contains neither NativeTypes nor ParseStructTag symbols, so the vulnerable code is not linked into the image.
